plan.criterion: Action from fixed native samples; environment contact from actually executed posture; native subsequent relative fields/action are outcomes, not imposed targets.

environment.posture_rule: Native0/+ both actuate left but distinct mechanical postures; native- actuates right. No movement has no contact.

result.attribution: General supplies fixed; actual post-actuation contact+posture transduced to a material sample. No old j0 return, no target direction or memory correction computed for the participant.
limitations: Prepared transduction/return anatomy; not learned sensor construction or routing.
Decoupled/sham/cut are identified diagnostic interventions, never native choices.
